info.name: Crewly HR API
info.description:
REST API of **Crewly**, the HR management system (Laravel 12 + Sanctum).

**Start here:** pick the *Crewly – local* environment, run **Auth → Get token as Admin** (or HR / Head / Employee). The token is saved in `{{token}}` and sent as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` by every request. Run the folders top to bottom: requests that create records save their ids (`{{departmentId}}`, `{{leaveId}}`, …) for the next ones.

**Demo accounts** (from `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`, password `password`): admin@test.com · hr@test.com · james@test.com (Head of Finance) · bobby@test.com (Finance employee).

**Roles:** Admin and HR manage staff, departments, settings and give the final leave sign-off; a Head approves their department first; everyone requests and sees their own leave.

**Errors** always look like `{ "code": "...", "message": "...", "errors": { "field": ["..."] } }` — see the *Error examples* folder.

Each request includes a saved example response recorded from the real API.
